substantive_checks.phase_tower: PASS: every anchored pattern J in a fixed diameter D follows (h-4j,s+3j,p+2j,M), with only O_D(1) boundary rows
substantive_checks.crt_module: PASS: on unit charts the exact solution module is the product of the local kernels and all local ranks 0, 1, and 2 are retained
substantive_checks.mixed_minors: PASS: each local gate supplies only two rows, so every four-row CRT minor meets orthogonal idempotent blocks and vanishes over Z/N_J Z
substantive_checks.transversality_witness: PASS: the exact 29,31,37 example has a determinant-one rational substack while all 15 CRT maximal minors vanish and a non-N-divisible common state survives
substantive_checks.valuation_overlap: PASS: a collision cluster yields only the already recorded square-radical factor; overlapping patterns must be radicalized and add no valuation
substantive_checks.sieve_mass: PASS: for fixed D and t the Selberg upper-bound sieve gives O_(D,t)(M/log^t M) clusters and O_(D,t)(M/log^(t-1) M)=o(M) endpoint log weight
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: the union of every fixed-D non-singleton cluster pattern is zero-rate, but D-isolated collision primes remain uncontrolled; the 1/36 ceiling and booking are unchanged

strict_scope.proved: All fixed-size, fixed-diameter non-singleton prime-cluster mechanisms on the fixed-j1 line have zero linear endpoint mass and no independent CRT determinant gain.
strict_scope.finite_only: The bounded phase and CRT witnesses are exact finite checks; the asymptotic conclusion comes only from the fixed-tuple upper-bound sieve.
strict_scope.open: D-isolated collision primes, diameter growing with M, non-natural cross-prime arithmetic invariants, and every positive j1 capacity reduction remain open.
